Garden of Memories Cemetery - Kerrville, TX - 830-257-6613

# A peaceful final resting place amidst the beauty of the Texas Hill Country.

Nestled amongst rolling hills and ancient oaks, Garden of Memories Cemetery offers a serene resting place.

Learn more

# A serene sanctuary for quiet contemplation and remembrance.

Our Memorial Chapel is place of peace, where families can gather to honor their loved ones in a dignified and comforting atmosphere.

Learn more

Garden of Memories Cemetery“Owning cemeteries goes hand-in-hand with our business. It’s good for the community.”- Stacey & Johnny Grimes of Grimes Funeral Chapels. As the new owners and operators of Garden of Memories Cemetery, we believe in providing a truly exceptional experience for families during their time of need. We offer a meticulously landscaped and serene environment, designed to foster a sense of peace and tranquility. Our compassionate staff goes above and beyond to ensure personalized attention and support, guiding families through every step of the process with care and understanding. From our thoughtfully designed memorial options to our commitment to maintaining a pristine and welcoming atmosphere, Garden of Memories is dedicated to honoring the lives of loved ones with dignity and respect.

## OUR SERVICES

Our cemetery services are distinguished by our unwavering commitment to compassion and personalized care. Our dedicated staff is available to provide guidance and support with empathy and understanding. We are honored to help families create meaningful tributes that celebrate the lives of their loved ones, ensuring their legacy endures for generations to come.

#### Burial Services

We take care of all the arrangements for laying your loved one to rest, whether in a traditional ground burial or within the peaceful surroundings of our mausoleum.

#### Mausoleum Entombment

We provide a secure and dignified resting place within our mausoleum, ensuring your loved one's casket is carefully placed and sealed within a chosen crypt.

#### Interment of Cremated Remains

We offer a variety of options for interring cremated remains, including placement in a mausoleum niche or a selection of ground burial locations.

#### Sale of Burial Plots and Mausoleum Crypts

We can help you choose the perfect final resting place for yourself or a loved one, offering a selection of burial plots and mausoleum crypts in various locations, sizes and price ranges.

#### Perpetual Care

We ensure the long-term maintenance and upkeep of the grounds and gravesites, offering families peace of mind knowing their loved ones' final resting places will remain beautiful and well-cared for in perpetuity.

#### Memorialization Options

We offer a range of personalized memorials to honor your loved one's memory, including headstones, grave markers, benches, plaques, and other tributes. We also sell markers, monuments, benches and plaques for your loved one's permanent memorial wherever they are buried.
